An '''individual''' was the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of the [[Dawferim]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Evram Darkmere]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] brother, [[Garreck Darkmere|Garreck]]. She was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Death/Legends|died]] during one of the long wars between the [[Botor Enclave/Legends|Botor Enclave]] and the [[Daupherm Planet States]].<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>
